name: Elder's Cap
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Elder's Cap

effects.name: Elder's Knowledge
effects.tooltip: Elder's Knowledge : +2% Artifact bonus to spell critical chance. 5% Legendary bonus to spell crit damage.

effects.name: Intelligence
effects.tooltip: Intelligence +5 : This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +5 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

effects.name: Concentration

flavor_text: Tribal drow elders use these caps to focus their minds and recall past events. They are passed down through the generations but few of them remain in existence.
